items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: We called him Professor. Victor Viall. ... He's good. You remember him, Victor Viall. He could play with Franky Duce and all of them, you know.

ctx.x: We ain't no piano player then.

Now he doesn't ever get a job. We were high piano players. We had to see a father sometime, uh... We called him Professor. Victor Viall. You ever heard him? No, I don't know. He's a sissy father, you know. He's good. You remember him, Victor Viall. He could play with Franky Duce and all of them, you know. But when we get a piano, you didn't hear some of the piano players coming up. No. No. Most of them was good. Yeah. Funny fellas, huh? Funny fellas, huh? Funny fellas, huh? Funny fellas, huh? Says the piano…
